message: なかよしこよし？

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan. Are you still not feeling well today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shouldn't you have stayed home and rested?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm fine! You're worrying too much!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Must be that time of the month!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go drop dead already!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Is it because Misasagi-senpai found out?」

name: Synn
message: 「Found out?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, no, it's nothing!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, it's nothing at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it something that'd be bad if I knew about it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Does it really matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, does it matter...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I tell you everything, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... w-well, I guess that's true.」
Of course it is. That's only natural. Yeah. Right. Still...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even you have things you don't tell me, right, Synn?」
I can't tell her... about the Demon Lord, after all.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, if it makes you worry about me this much, maybe feeling under the weather isn't so bad once in a while.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「J-Just kidding! Totally joking.\s04」
If it makes me worry about her, maybe feeling under the weather isn't so bad once in a while... huh.

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder why strong demons always attack separately?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite ignorant, Vice President. Their brains are severely lacking. Their stupidity doesn't even compare to angels.」

name: Sally
message: 「You're not smart either, Loro-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am smart! And before that, I'm not an angel, you know?」
It's just a joke, right. Probably.
Yet why does it bother me so much. Lately, it's always on my mind.

name: Ria
message: 「I bet it's because strong people have strong egos, so it's hard for them to work together.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's Ria-chan for ya.」

name: Sally
message: 「Before that, strategies and stuff are a pain.」
Worrying is only natural as a childhood friend... It is natural, right?
To me, Nanaka is a childhood friend and basically my best friend...

name: Ria
message: 「Regardless of the reason, we're lucky that hasn't happened. If the person from the other day and Pasta-chan had attacked at the same time, we would've lost.」

name: Misa
message: 「That is true, however...」
Suddenly, Nanaka's index finger touched her own lips.
My heart skipped a beat.
B-But that was an accident, and we talked it out and settled things...
Nanaka glanced over in my direction.
We both reflexively looked away.
She's self-conscious about it too. Nanaka is.
You can't just pretend something that happened never happened, huh...
Still, even so... we're still just childhood friends.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The school gate's gonna close pretty soon~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Is it that late already?」

name: Ria
message: 「Time sure flies, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's call it a day here.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today was another fun Student Council session!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Coming in!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't have to go out of your way to come get me--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hurry along home now, Nanaka-han.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why would I go with you?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you don't hurry up and get today's assignments out of the way, won't it get in the way of your actual business?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, why you?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, are the assignments really getting that tough?」
Misasagi-senpai glanced over at Nanaka, and--

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that sigh?! Are you trying to say I'm an idiot?! That's it, isn't it?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I never once said you were a pitiful little thing, now did I? I merely let out a sigh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan. You shouldn't tease Nanaka-chan.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm not teasing her. The two of us actually get along quite well, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Can I punch you once?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm honored that you feel so passionately about me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No! Not at all.」
